Customers visit the izakaya at night to order [[Dishes]] and [[Drinks]] in exchange for money. Each customer has varied preferences for the properties on their ordered items. Each type of customer may visit the izakaya at one or multiple locations. Rare customers have a bond level that can be increased by tailoring dishes and drinks to suit their tastes. This type of customer will have specific properties desired for each requested dish. If you have sufficiently high bond with a rare customer, you can invite them to your izakaya for a chance for them to show up outside of their standard areas. Special guests function in almost the same way as rare customers except they do not gain bond and cannot be invited to the izakaya.

== The Rating System ==
Common Customers and Rare Customers rate the meals they receive in different ways. However, most colors are available for both.

* Black (Mad): The worst rating. Satisfaction goes down. Rare Customers will activate their punishment spell cards. The combo is broken. Customers who are kicked out will automatically give a black rating, but Rare Customers will not trigger punishments in this case.
* Purple (Dissatisfied): The second worst rating. Satisfaction goes down. The combo is broken. Only Rare Customers give this rating.
* Green (Fair): Average rating. Nothing happens.
* Orange (Satisfied): Second-highest rating for Rare Customers, highest for Common Customers. Satisfaction goes up.
* Pink (Perfect): The best rating for Rare Customers: unavailable for Common Customers. Reward spell cards are activated, and satisfaction goes up even faster.

For Common Customers:

* Black: An unrequested drink or dish is served.
* Green: The requested drink and dish are both served.
* Orange: The requested drink and dish are both served. Additionally, at least one '''added''' food tag that matches the preferences of the '''ordering''' customer needs to be present.<!-- There are "innate additional tags" like economical, expensive, or any of the cookware tags. Practically, this doesn't matter since they were never used for commons, but this is probably the most factually accurate way to phrase the mechanic. -->

For Rare Customers (and Special Guests):

* Liked tags from drink and dish add one point; disliked tags from dish subtract one point.
* The [[Dark Matter]] tag subtracts 2 points (with exceptions, e.g. during a quest)
* Ratings are then given based on the point total and request fulfillment:
** Black: 0 points or lower.
** Purple: 1 point. This is the maximum rating if neither requested tag is fulfilled.
** Green: 2 points.
** Orange: 3 points. This is the maximum rating if only one requested tag is fulfilled.
** Pink: 4 points or higher.
* If a served dish is made with any [[Stations#Night Sparrow Series|Night Sparrow Series]] cookware while hyper mode is active or the sparrow tune is played perfectly, requested tags are ignored.
*There are a few additional interactions with unique effects; these have priority over the usual mechanics.
**Giving [[Komeiji Koishi|Koishi]] [[Unconscious Youkai Mousse|a meal shaped after her hat]] will prompt a unique response and force a black rating.
**Giving [[Kawashiro Nitori|Nitori]] any food item containing [[Cucumber|cucumbers]], whether it was part of the recipe or added later, will give an orange rating at worst.
**Giving [[Medicine Melancholy|Medicine]] [[Dark Matter]] will prompt a unique response and give at least an orange rating.
** Giving [[Remilia Scarlet|Remilia]] [[Scarlet Devil Cake|a meal shaped after her hat]] will prompt a unique response and force a pink rating.
If a Rare Customer goes over their budget, they will pay what they can and then immediately leave. If they are only minorly overbudget, they will leave a mostly favorable comment in a green text box. If they are majorly overbudget, they will instead complain with a black text box and trigger a punishment card. Whether it should be a green or black comment is dependent on their current satisfaction level, the amount overspent, and the Rare Customer in question. These comment boxes do not factor into the stats of the night.

==Common Customers==
In addition to their preferred tags, all common customers like Trend - Popular. While common customers do not have any disliked tags, Trend - Unpopular still makes a dish less likely to be ordered.

Two common customers may share the same table. If they do, the one ordering will be displayed above their order when their table is selected.

==Rare Customers==
Along with the regular unlocks listed on each rare customer's page, all rare customers unlock the ability to be invited to the izakaya when bond level 2 is reached, the dialogue option ''About Ingredients'' when bond level 3 is reached, and the dialogue option ''About Drinks'' when bond level 4 is reached. At level 5, characters give a unique bonus. Each area has: 

*A character that unlocks the ''About Gathering'' option, which gives the player the ingredients and drinks given by every gathering spot in the area at 18:00 ([[Wriggle Nightbug|Wriggle]], [[Hieda no Akyuu|Akyuu]], [[Ibuki Suika|Suika]], [[Cirno]], [[Fujiwara no Mokou|Mokou]], [[Alice]], [[Inubashiri Momiji|Momiji]], [[Kurodani Yamame|Yamame]], [[Kaenbyou Rin|Orin]], [[Kogasa Tatara|Kogasa]], [[Soga no Tojiko|Tojiko]], [[Medicine Melancholy|Medicine]], [[Shinmyoumaru Sukuna|Shinmyoumaru]]).
*A character that gives an [https://touhou-mystias-izakaya.fandom.com/wiki/Items#Izakaya_Items Izakaya Item], an item that can be activated in Mystia's basement, granting a minor bonus while enabled. They could also give a station instead of an Izakaya item. ([[Chen]], [[Ibaraki Kasen|Kasen]], [[Hinanawi Tenshi|Tenshi]], [[Hong Meiling|Meiling]], [[Inaba Tewi|Tewi]], [[Yatadera Narumi|Narumi]], [[Kawashiro Nitori|Nitori]], [[Mizuhashi Parsee|Parsee]], [[Komeiji Satori|Satori]], [[Nue Houjuu|Nue]], [[Mononobe no Futo|Futo]], [[Aya Shameimaru|Aya]]).
*A character that gives an equippable costume ([[Rumia]], [[Kamishirasawa Keine|Keine]], [[Hakurei Reimu|Reimu]], [[Patchouli Knowledge|Patchouli]], [[Houraisan Kaguya|Kaguya]], [[Kirisame Marisa|Marisa]], [[Kochiya Sanae|Sanae]], [[Hoshiguma Yuugi|Yuugi]], [[Reiuji Utsuho|Utsuho]], [[Minamitsu Murasa|Minamitsu]], [[Seiga Kaku|Seiga]], [[Yuuka Kazami|Yuuka]], [[Seija Kijin|Seija]]).

All bond reward dialogue options take 30 minutes of time. The ''About'' ''Ingredients/Drinks'' dialogue option provides a few random Ingredients/Drinks that the character likes; rarer Ingredients and Drinks are less likely to be obtained. The likelihood of a character accepting an invite increases with their bond level, up to 100% at max. Although even if they accept the invitation, they could end up not reaching a table if they appear too late and get stuck in line.

==Special Guests==
Special guests behave functionally identical to Rare Customers, but lack the bond system and all related functionalities; including invitation and bond rewards. They do not appear in the overworld except as shopkeepers.

[[Kirisame Marisa|Marisa]]'s categorization depends on the presence of DLC1. Without it, she is a Special Guest. With it, she is a Rare Customer found in the [[Forest of Magic]], where the player can bond with her.{{#invoke:Customer|get_special_guest_list}}<gallery>
